description: This file contains utility functions for parsing system metrics, resource usage, and log analysis within a Kubernetes environment. It includes methods to extract metrics from logs, system commands, and perform various system health checks, specifically relevant to monitoring radio access metrics, CPU, memory, disk, and SCTP status for containers and pods.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_metrics_from_text(log_text: str)
methods.description: Parses radio access metrics from log text, counting errors and connection events.

methods.name: None _update_metrics_from_line(metrics: Dict[str, Any], line: str, lower: str)
methods.description: Updates metrics counters based on individual log lines.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_cpu_from_top(output: str)
methods.description: Parses CPU utilization percentage from 'top' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[float]] _parse_mem_from_free(output: str)
methods.description: Extracts memory usage metrics from 'free -m' command output.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _parse_df_h(output: str)
methods.description: Parses disk usage information from 'df -h' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_sctp_ss(output: str)
methods.description: Detects SCTP status from 'ss' command output.

methods.name: List[str] _container_names_from_pod(pod: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts container names from a pod dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[float] _num_from_text(s: str)
methods.description: Extracts the first number found in a string as a float.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[float]] _mem_calculate_from_kv(kv: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Calculates memory metrics from /proc/meminfo key-value pairs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] collect_logs_and_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_bytes: int = 50000)
methods.description: Main public interface function that fetches logs, parses metrics, and collects container system metrics for a list of pods.
